world.title: As Ukraine hits Russia's refineries, Russia targets Ukraine's petrol pumps
world.summary: Ukraine has targeted Russian refineries, prompting retaliatory strikes on petrol stations in Ukraine. Kharkiv's Mayor Ihor Terekhov advised residents to "fill up quickly and move on" due to safety concerns. On Monday, Russian drones attacked two petrol stations in Kharkiv, resulting in injuries to two individuals. Fuel companies are urging customers to avoid lingering at the pumps.

world.title: Israeli military sent US universities millions for weapons research: Report
world.summary: The Israeli Ministry of Defense and defense companies have reportedly funneled over $15 million into weapons-related research at U.S. universities. Audit records reveal this funding is part of a broader initiative to enhance military technology and capabilities. The financial support aims to foster collaboration between Israeli defense sectors and academic institutions in the United States.

world.title: Photos: Rohingya refugees rally nine years after Myanmar exodus
world.summary: Tens of thousands of Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh protested to mark nine years since their exodus from Myanmar due to a military crackdown. The demonstrators demanded safe return to Rakhine state and highlighted the dire conditions in overcrowded camps. More than 1.2 million Rohingya refugees currently reside in Bangladesh, facing ongoing challenges and uncertainty about their future.

business.title: Bank holiday today, 26 August: Will SBI, HDFC and others remain open on Eid-e-Milad-un-Nabi?
business.summary: Banks in various Indian states will be closed on August 26 to observe Eid-e-Milad-un-Nabi, marking the birth of Prophet Muhammad. Major banks, including SBI and HDFC, will not operate on this day. Customers are advised to plan their banking activities accordingly, as services will be unavailable in regions observing the holiday.

business.title: Carlisle Investors to approach PMO over alleged HDFC Bank mis-selling
business.summary: Investors are set to contact the Prime Minister's Office this week regarding alleged mis-selling and significant losses linked to a Carlisle product. They also plan to approach the Reserve Bank of India and are considering legal action against HDFC Bank for purported lapses in client suitability. The group aims to address their grievances through these channels.

business.title: Nvidia Customers Face a 15% Price Hike | Google Is Spending $200 Billion to Steal Them
business.summary: Nvidia has informed major customers of a potential 15% price increase for next-generation AI servers featuring Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin chips, expected in early 2027 due to rising memory costs. This situation presents an opportunity for competitors, including Google, which is reportedly investing $200 billion to attract Nvidia's clients amid the price hike.

technology.title: Sony Launches the Xperia 10 VIII, But It's Not Coming to the US
technology.summary: Sony has launched the Xperia 10 VIII, featuring a 50MP main camera, a brighter 120Hz OLED display, and a 5,000mAh battery. The new mid-range smartphone includes a slight redesign and enhancements in display, camera, and audio. However, it will not be available in the US market, and the price has seen a significant increase.

technology.title: Vivo V70 Lite 4G Has an 8,100mAh Battery and IP69 Rating, but There Is a Catch
technology.summary: The Vivo V70 Lite 4G features an 8,100mAh battery, IP69 water and dust resistance, and a 6.83-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate. It has been listed in Eurasian markets, but its Unisoc T7300 chip raises concerns about its target audience. The device appears to offer high-end specifications at a budget price.

technology.title: 'The Witcher 3: Remastered' drops on Sept. 29 - with SURPRISE Xbox Play Anywhere support and FSR 4.0 for the Xbox Ally. Here's what's new.
technology.summary: The Witcher 3: Remastered will be released on September 29, 2026, featuring Xbox Play Anywhere support and FSR 4.0 for the Xbox Ally. The announcement comes during Gamescom 2026, where several new titles for Xbox have been revealed. The remastered version aims to enhance the gaming experience with various new features, marking a significant update for fans.

sports.title: Pakistan provide update on Babar Azam ahead of Lord's Test
sports.summary: Pakistan's Test captain Babar Azam is recovering from a finger injury sustained in the West Indies and aggravated during a practice match. He was observed batting at Lord's on Tuesday. Pakistan's bowling coach Umar Gul confirmed that Babar is expected to return for the second Test against England, which is scheduled to begin on Thursday.

sports.title: Caruana Leads Praggnanandhaa In Final Match, Keymer-So Stays Even
sports.summary: GM Fabiano Caruana secured victory in the first classical game of the title match against GM Praggnanandhaa Rameshbabu during the 2026 Grand Chess Tour Finals, earning six points. The match featured an unusual variant of the Italian Opening, where Praggnanandhaa managed to maintain competitiveness. Meanwhile, the match between Keymer and So remains evenly contested, with no clear leader.

sports.title: Farjana Easmin replaces injured Trishna in Bangladesh squad for Asia Cup, Asian Games
sports.summary: Farjana Easmin, a 17-year-old uncapped bowling all-rounder, has been added to Bangladesh's squad for the Women's Asia Cup 2026 in Dubai and the 20th Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya. She replaces left-arm pacer Fariha Islam Trishna, who has been diagnosed with a Grade II tear in her right thigh and is expected to be sidelined for four to six weeks.

health.title: Hyderabad doctor leads epilepsy breakthrough
health.summary: Paediatric neurologist Dr. Kavitha Kothur from Hyderabad has contributed to a medical breakthrough in Australia, where an eight-month-old baby became the first globally to receive precision medicine for a rare form of epilepsy. This innovative treatment aims to improve the child's condition, marking a significant advancement in epilepsy care and potentially influencing future therapeutic approaches for similar cases.

health.title: Heart disease in women is often misunderstood: Doctor busts 5 myths that could delay diagnosis and treatment
health.summary: Heart disease in women is frequently misinterpreted, leading to delayed diagnosis and treatment. Common myths suggest that women must exhibit dramatic symptoms like chest pain, while they may instead experience subtler signs such as breathlessness, fatigue, or nausea. Dr. Binay Kumar emphasizes the importance of recognizing these misconceptions to improve awareness and outcomes for women's heart health.

health.title: How Much Creatine Per Day? Dosage and Safety Guide
health.summary: The recommended daily dose of creatine monohydrate is 3-5 grams, according to the International Society of Sports Nutrition (ISSN). This amount is sufficient to maintain elevated muscle creatine levels after saturation. The article discusses whether a loading phase is necessary, factors related to body weight, timing of intake, and overall safety for healthy adults, referencing NHS guidelines.

science.title: Spectacled cobras in India genetically same despite visible differences
science.summary: Research by the Evolutionary Venomics Lab (EVL) reveals that spectacled cobras (Naja naja) in India are genetically identical despite their visible differences. This species, responsible for approximately 58,000 snakebite fatalities annually in the country, is crucial for developing more effective anti-venoms. The findings emphasize the importance of understanding genetic uniformity in addressing public health challenges related to snakebites.

science.title: Mountain trees are moving in opposite directions as the climate warms
science.summary: As climate change progresses, mountain trees are exhibiting varied movement patterns. Some species are migrating uphill, while others are spreading downhill. This shift alters mountain forests' composition at different elevations, where broadleaf trees transition to fir and spruce. Although many tree bands are moving higher, a significant number are not following this expected trend, complicating ecological dynamics.

entertainment.title: Virgo Horoscope Today: August 26, 2026

While Virgos may not be seen as overly romantic, they understand the importance of both emotional and mental aspects in life. The horoscope suggests that Virgos should acknowledge their romantic side while also recognizing the necessity of practical considerations in their relationships.

entertainment.summary: Capricorn horoscope for August 26, 2026, emphasizes the importance of aligning thoughts with reality. This message has been consistently highlighted, suggesting a need for introspection and thoughtful decision-making to achieve desired outcomes. Focus on balance is crucial during this period.
